2116538195307552942.en_summary: Visa and Mastercard expect sustained double-digit revenue growth: $V CFO: "Pulling this all together, with strength across our growth pillars of consumer, CMS and VAS, we expect full year adjusted net revenue growth to be in the low double digits, with Q2 being the growth low point as a result of lapping the very strong performance last year." $MA CFO: "For the full year 2026, we expect net revenue growth to remain at the high end of low double digits range on a currency-neutral basis, excluding inorganic activity."

2116536906339307987.en_summary: One of most overlooked opportunities for $NBIS, $CRWV and $DOCN is how much more revenue they could eventually generate from every megawatt of AI compute. Right now DigitalOcean generates ~$20M per MW through higher-value cloud services while CoreWeave sits around $10M and just ~$7M for Nebius which is still bringing capacity online faster than it can fill it while large hyperscaler contracts like $META and $MSFT also tend to carry lower pricing. And with all three projected to approach $25M per MW by 2035 I think the opportunity goes beyond adding capacity as CoreWeave improves utilization while Nebius's Token Factory and DigitalOcean's inference services help them earn more from same infrastructure.
2116536906339307987.zh_summary: $NBIS、$CRWV和$DOCN最被忽視的機會之一是它們最終能從每兆瓦AI計算中產生多少更多收入。目前DigitalOcean透過更高價值雲服務每MW產生約2000萬美元，而CoreWeave約1000萬美元，Nebius僅約700萬美元，後者仍在比填充更快地上線容量，而像$META和$MSFT的大型超大規模合約也傾向於較低定價。而隨著這三家預計到2035年接近每MW 2500萬美元，我認為機會超越增加容量，因為CoreWeave改善利用率，而Nebius的Token Factory和DigitalOcean的推理服務幫助它們從相同基礎設施賺取更多。

ticker_notes.NBIS: 每MW收入有提升空間至2500萬
